compress.dialog_description: Uses the context compression model from Scene models to summarize earlier messages while keeping recent ones.
compress.workspace_description: Compacts the workspace engine's working memory: the current chat model summarizes earlier execution history. Your message history in the UI stays intact, and the next generation uses the compacted context.
compress.manual_hint: Manual compression can run at any time — no need to wait until the context is nearly full; automatic compression only kicks in at the threshold. Original messages stay available to expand.
compress.ratio_hint: The summary keeps about {{kept}}% of the current context (~{{target}} tokens out of ~{{context}}).
compress.ratio_hint_no_context: No context usage is available yet; the server default summary length will be used.
compress.ratio_warning_description: Above 65%, the summary keeps less than 35% of the original detail. Missing details can make the model invent facts in later answers.
compress.keep_recent_hint: Any count works (e.g. 8 or 100). 0 compresses as much as possible while still keeping 1 message as the cut anchor.
compress.additional_placeholder: Optional, e.g. keep character relationships, key parameters, and to-dos
compress.aborted: Compression stopped — your context is unchanged

create.managed_hint: Managed by the app, ready to use
create.folder_hint: AI will operate on this directory; requires your trust
create.folder_dialog_desc: Pick a real directory as the workspace root. After you grant trust, AI can read, write and run commands in it.
create.folder_path_placeholder: Type or pick a directory path…
create.ssh_hint: Bind to a remote directory already authorized under Extensions › SSH
create.ssh_dialog_desc: The workspace only references one directory registered under Extensions › SSH — host, port and credentials live there and cannot be changed here.
create.ssh_name_placeholder: Defaults to the remote directory name

ssh.none_configured: There is no SSH device to bind yet. Add a device under Settings › Extensions › SSH and register at least one authorized remote directory for it.
ssh.host_key_unconfirmed: This server's host key has not been confirmed yet — confirm it before this workspace can be used. Click to open Settings.
ssh.capability_hint: A remote workspace mounts only the read and bash tools: the AI can read files inside the boundary and run commands as the SSH user; editing files goes through bash (same as the mobile app — there are no write/edit tools). Commands are not confined to that directory, so only bind directories you really mean to hand over.
ssh.missing_desc: The device or authorized directory behind this workspace is gone, so the AI cannot use it right now. Your conversations are kept — bind another authorized directory and it works again.

trust.title: Trust this folder?
trust.description: Once granted, AI gains the following abilities (revocable in Settings at any time):
trust.point_rw: Read and modify all files inside this directory
trust.point_shell: Run shell commands in this directory (commands can reach beyond it)
trust.point_revoke: Dangerous commands and writes outside the workspace require your approval by default; permissions are adjustable anytime

empty.managed_intro: Files here are co-maintained by you and the AI (^^;)
empty.folder_intro: The AI can read, write and run commands in this directory. Start with a single sentence
empty.ssh_intro: The AI can read this remote machine and run commands on it
empty.missing_desc: The folder this workspace is bound to no longer exists or was moved. The AI can't read or write files until you rebind it to a folder (its conversations are kept as-is).

menu.delete_confirm_desc: Only removes the workspace record and conversations; files on disk are untouched.
menu.missing_hint: This folder can't be found. Rebind to a new folder (trust authorization is required again after rebinding)
menu.rebind_notice: Path changed — trust authorization is required again after saving

shell.title: No usable bash shell found
shell.desc: The built-in terminal is being prepared in the background — re-check in a moment, or point to your own bash in Settings. Until then, the AI falls back to built-in read-only grep / find / ls tools.
shell.recheck_ok: Bash detected — conversations now get the full toolset
shell.recheck_fail: Still no usable bash — retry in a moment (the built-in terminal is still being prepared), or set a bash path in Settings
